reelprototypes

Four demos, one idea

Everything you copy, save or attach in a day is scattered across a dozen apps. These are working sketches of getting it back in one gesture — without leaving whatever app you are already in.

Nothing uploads. Everything stays in this browser, and “start over” on any page wipes it.

The appWhere things land and get organised. Capture, search, pin, and the rolling buffer that quietly forgets what you never use. The extensionsThe dial and the vault keyboard, tested against a real errand: applying for a job without leaving the form. The iOS surfacesSpotlight, Shortcuts and the attach sheet — how this works on a platform that will not give you an overlay. The fill sessionA long form, one item at a time, driven from the Dynamic Island.
a Shipaton 2026 project, built in public
“Reel” is a working title, not a decision
